# Dheeran Movers & Storage (Singapore)

> Reliable, affordable house moving, HDB relocation, condo moving, office moving, and furniture storage across all regions of Singapore.

## Official Contact & Booking
- **Company Name:** Dheeran Movers & Storage
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +65 8407 6882 (https://wa.me/6584076882)
- **Website:** https://thiruaji.github.io/singapore-cheap-movers/
- **Service Area:** Islandwide Singapore (East, North-East, North, West, Central — all 28 districts, no distance surcharge)
- **Operating Hours:** Daily, 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM (including weekends & public holidays)

## Transparent Moving Packages (SGD)
1. **1x 10ft Covered Truck Package — $200 / trip**
   - Manpower: 1 Driver + 1 Helper
   - Best for: Single room moves, studio apartments, small furniture loads
   - Included Free: Protective stretch-film furniture wrapping, 30 carton boxes (return collection), and basic dismantling & assembly (basic TV wall-mount brackets, sofa legs, basic dining tables, standard bedframes).

2. **1x 14ft Covered Truck Package — $350 / trip**
   - Manpower: 14ft Truck with 2 Helpers
   - Best for: 2–3 Room HDB flats, 1–2 Bedroom Condominiums, light 4-Room moves, or Office relocations
   - Included Free: Full protective furniture wrapping, 30 carton boxes (return collection), basic dismantling & assembly (basic TV wall-mount brackets, sofa legs, basic dining tables, standard bedframes), and Condo MCST permit documentation.

3. **2x 14ft Covered Trucks Package — $700 / 2 trips**
   - Manpower: 2x 14ft Truck loads with 2 Helpers
   - Best for: Full 4–5 Room HDB flats, 3-Bedroom Condominiums, Executive Apartments, and Landed Homes
   - Included Free: Full protective wrapping, 30–60 carton boxes (return collection), and basic dismantling & assembly.

## Included FREE vs. Special Item Add-Ons
### Included at $0 Extra Charge:
- Protective stretch-film furniture wrapping
- Up to 30 carton boxes (delivered early; we collect the empty boxes back for free after you unpack)
- Basic TV wall-mount bracket dismantling
- Sofa legs dismantling & reassembly
- Basic dining table dismantling & reassembly
- Standard bedframe dismantling & reassembly

### Low-Cap Special Item Add-Ons ($25 – $40 per item):
- Storage / hydraulic bed dismantling & reassembly: **$25 – $40**
- Fridge door removal & reinstallation: **$25 – $40**
- IKEA / sliding door wardrobe dismantling & reassembly: **$25 – $40**
